prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1073; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers were dispatched to a sideswipe collision on a multi-lane roadway in Pasadena, Texas. Upon arrival, Driver 1 stated that while changing lanes, the vehicle was contacted along the right rear quarter panel by Driver 2's vehicle, which had been traveling in the adjacent lane. Driver 2 confirmed this account and acknowledged the lane change was not signaled. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time and was present at the scene, and both officers and independent witnesses confirmed the Passenger's presence in the vehicle. Two witnesses in a nearby vehicle stated they saw the contact occur and described it consistently with the drivers' statements. Photographs taken at the scene show scraping and deformation along the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and damage to the left front area of Driver 2's vehicle, which is generally consistent with the reported impact. No prior damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported for evaluation. It is not yet clear whether the wrist injury resulted from this collision, and the medical records will need to be reviewed. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
